entities.summary: The Baptist Union of Norway is a Baptist Christian denomination in Norway. It is affiliated with the Baptist World Alliance. The headquarters is in Stabekk. Norwegian Baptist Union is a religious organization in Europe, established in 1879. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
